# Rip Packs City

## Overview
Rip Packs City (RPC) is a collector intelligence platform for Flow blockchain NFT collectibles. Founded by Trevor Dillon-Bond, an Official Portland Trail Blazers Team Captain on NBA Top Shot.

Five collections are live and supported across the platform: NBA Top Shot, NFL All Day, LaLiga Golazos, Disney Pinnacle, and UFC Strike. Every collection exposes wallet analytics, FMV pricing, marketplace browser, and a sniper feed; pack EV, set completion, and analytics tabs scale across collections as data coverage allows.

## Supported Collections

### NBA Top Shot
- Contract: 0x0b2a3299cc857e29 (TopShot)
- Tiers: Common, Fandom, Rare, Legendary, Ultimate
- Features: Wallet analytics, FMV, sniper deals, set completion, pack EV
- Badge metadata (rendered inline on Collection / Market / Sniper rows): Rookie Year, Top Shot Debut, Rookie Premiere, Rookie of the Year, Rookie Mint, Championship Year, #1 Serial, Jersey Match, Perfect Mint
- Series: Series 1, Series 2, Summer 2021, Series 3, Series 4, Series 2023-24, Series 2024-25, Series 2025-26
- URLs: /nba-top-shot/collection, /nba-top-shot/sniper, /nba-top-shot/packs, /nba-top-shot/sets, /nba-top-shot/market, /nba-top-shot/analytics

### NFL All Day
- Contract: 0xe4cf4bdc1751c65d (AllDay)
- Tiers: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Legendary, Ultimate
- Features: Wallet analytics, FMV, sniper deals, set completion, pack browser
- URLs: /nfl-all-day/collection, /nfl-all-day/sniper, /nfl-all-day/packs, /nfl-all-day/sets

- Tiers: Common, Fandom, Rare, Legendary
- Features: Wallet analytics, FMV, sniper deals, set completion

- Contract: Pinnacle (Flow)
- Tiers: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Legendary
- Features: Wallet analytics, FMV, sniper deals
- Marketplace: disneypinnacle.com (not Flowty)
- URLs: /disney-pinnacle/collection, /disney-pinnacle/sniper

### UFC Strike
- Contract: 0x329feb3ab062d289 (UFC_NFT)
- Tiers: Challenger, Contender, Fandom
- Features: Wallet analytics, FMV, sniper deals
- Note: UFC Strike migrated to Aptos in July 2025; RPC supports the remaining Flow collector base
- URLs: /ufc/collection, /ufc/sniper

## Platform Features
- **FMV Engine (v1.5.1)**: Outlier-filtered weighted average price, recency decay, liquidity rating (0–5), serial multiplier, deal rating (0–1), lowest ask flag. Refreshed every 20 minutes per collection.
- **Sniper Feed**: Real-time listings below FMV from native marketplaces and Flowty. Deduped, sorted by recency. Per-collection data sources.
- **Market Browser (Phase 3)**: Sortable / filterable marketplace listings per collection — tier, price, discount, player. URL-synced filter state.
- **Analytics suite at /analytics**: live cross-collection intelligence. Surfaces:
  - **/analytics** — homepage and Pulse dashboard (volume, growth, ecosystem health)
  - **/analytics/sales** — sortable sales feed, leaderboards, marketplace mix, period-over-period deltas
  - **/analytics/listings** — open marketplace listings, order-book depth, locked vs liquid
  - **/analytics/loans** — Flowty loan offers, funded loans, lender performance
  - **/analytics/wallets** — wallet hub overview, position transfers, biggest sales, retention cohorts
  - **/analytics/fmv** — FMV index, top movers, tier pulse, pipeline health (5 collections)
  - **/analytics/packs** — live pack EV dashboard with top-EV table and fresh drops
  - **/analytics/sets** — set/edition counts, tier breakdown, series overview (5 collections)
- **Per-collection analytics tab**: each collection has Market and Portfolio sub-tabs at /{collection-id}/analytics. Market shows order-book depth, FMV health, pack EV, loans book, whale leaderboard, plus ecosystem-wide breakdowns. Portfolio analyzes a wallet — origin story, liquid vs locked, marketplace breakdown, tier/series breakdown, clarity score.
- **Wallet Analytics**: Any Flow wallet — moment inventory, FMV totals, cost basis, P&L, acquisition history, badge detection.
- **Set Completion**: Track owned vs needed, bottleneck finder, cheapest completion path.
- **Pack Tools**: Pack browser with EV calculator, tier breakdown, buy/skip signal.
- **Email Sign-In (Phase 1)**: Magic-link authentication required for every collection tool. Users sign in at /login. Public /profile/[username] shareable pages remain open.
- **Multi-Collection Profile (Phase 4)**: Hero Holo Moment card, saved wallets across collections, 6-slot trophy case, favorite collections (drives per-collection news feed), follows system, friend activity feed (last 20 sales over 7 days from followed users' wallets), recent searches.
- **AI Concierge v2 (Phase 4)**: Claude Sonnet-powered, multi-collection aware. Knows which collection you're browsing from the URL and scopes queries accordingly. New search_across_collections tool handles cross-collection lookups (e.g. "does RPC have Messi?"). Tools: search_live_deals, search_catalog_deals, get_fmv, check_wallet, search_across_collections, plus watchlist/alerts/escalation.
- **Public Profiles**: Shareable collector profiles at /profile/[username] with trophy case, bio, and privacy-stripped saved-wallet summaries. No auth required to view.

## FMV Methodology
Weighted average price from recent on-chain sales with recency decay. Confidence tiers: HIGH (multiple recent sales), MEDIUM (sparse data), LOW (single sale or stale). Serial premiums applied for #1, jersey match, and perfect mint serials. Badge premiums are market-baked and not applied as multipliers.

## Technical Stack
- Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind 4
- Supabase (PostgreSQL) — editions, FMV snapshots, listings cache, wallet cache
- Flow blockchain via FCL — on-chain reads, cart/purchase via Dapper
- Vercel Pro deployment
- Data pipelines via cron-job.org (every 20 minutes)

## URL Structure
- Homepage: /
- About: /about
- Collection pages: /{collection-id}/{page}
- Profiles: /profile/[username]
- API: /api/sniper-feed, /api/wallet-search, /api/edition-history, /api/market-analytics
